description: Defines a Dart class 'KycData' that models 'Know Your Customer' information for a mobile app. It includes serialization methods to convert instances to/from JSON, with specific fields for personal identification data.

classes.name: KycData
classes.description: A data model class that holds KYC information such as name, date of birth, address, and ID number, with methods for JSON serialization.

methods.description: Creates a copy of the current KycData instance with optional updated fields.

methods.description: Serializes the KycData instance to a JSON-compatible map.

methods.description: Factory method to create a KycData instance from a JSON map.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Converts a KycData instance into a JSON string.

methods.description: Creates a KycData instance from a JSON string.
